⚠ DUE SOON: humans& coding interview Tue Nov 17, 6:45pm ET (booked, you confirmed) — prep. No OA deadlines open. Past/closed: Cisco take-home review (Nov 12), Steadyworks (Nov 13), Nascent (Nov 13) — outcomes pending, no replies seen; none owed by you.

FUNNEL (partial — sheet unreadable): mail-sweep 8-day window found 0 OA, 4 interview threads (Cisco, humans&, Steadyworks, Nascent), 1 human recruiter reply (Chakra Labs, you answered), 0 rejections, 35 alert roles (24 already in ledger by company name; the rest NOT triaged — weekly has no scan/triage). Last 7 morning runs: ~1,500 scanned/day, 12-33 kept/day, 41-130 dropped by triage, 0 verified (posting hosts blocked, so every kept row is unverified_newgrad). Interviews are coming from mail/alert-driven roles, not from any ATS feed.
SCAN HEALTH: 31 source errors every day, all 'Tunnel connection failed: 403' from the egress proxy — all ATS feeds (Ashby/Greenhouse/Lever) unreachable, so the watchlist contributes 0 candidates; only lists + LinkedIn alerts work. Stale Applied >14d: NOT computable (sheet unreadable). Overdue Referrals follow-ups: NOT computable; no nudges drafted. 
SIGNALS: signal-sync returned 0 (recruitinginsights.xyz and cscareers.dev both 403 from proxy) — no watchlist additions (0 companies reached the >=3 threshold).
PRUNES: none proposed. All 42 watchlist rows show Last Hit/Added >30d, but that is the blocked-fetch artifact, not dead companies — treat as REPAIR (rung: egress allowlist for boards-api.greenhouse.io, api.ashbyhq.com, api.lever.co). Separately: Google (robots-disallowed), Tesla (blanket 403) are standing reference-only; 8 careers-page rows with blank Feed URL (Groq, Meta, Mistral, Modular, NVIDIA, Reflection, SambaNova, SSI) need a feed URL once egress works.
NEXT WEEK: The pipeline has run degraded for 7+ weeks: three hosts (script.google.com, recruitinginsights.xyz, ATS APIs) are blocked by the environment's network policy, so the sheet is never written, the funnel is never measured, and pending_sheet_appends_*.tsv files pile up in state/ (~240 rows) that nobody pastes. The highest-value change is not tuning fit thresholds but allowlisting those hosts in the routine's environment (or switching the sheet write to the Drive/Sheets connector); until then paste the pending TSVs into the SWE tab by hand and stop letting 15-30 unverified rows/day accumulate. Also decide whether the research/RL-flavored roles that are actually getting interviews belong on the MLE tab.
ERRORS: (1) sheets_writer unreachable — script.google.com 403 from proxy; sheet NOT read or written; 4 mail updates (Cisco, humans&, Steadyworks, Nascent -> Interview scheduled) are unmatched appends, saved as state/pending_sheet_appends_2026-11-15-weekly.tsv (no sheet_index, so rows may duplicate existing ones — check). (2) signal-sync 403, 0 rows. (3) No Calendar entries (no deadline-bearing OA; humans& Nov 17 interview already has an invite). (4) 35 alert roles not triaged; seen.txt gains nothing from them. (5) Fallbacks: TSV file for sheet writes; empty signals.
